observations: Historical explicit camp rest checks authority, party location and tent inventory, clips a common disease/injury interval, and applies field-shelter weather exposure after each member clock write. It orders rest recovery, convalescence, maintenance, eligible training and chats, then records camp rest, narrative boundaries and forecast. This does not establish exposure coverage for planned movement or treatment; a separately attributed 95e trace addresses those paths.

The official clock uses an epoch and stores a minute projection, while a character retains a separate subjective chronology. Family propagation collects eligible living related NPCs, excludes the subject and limits the list to 32, then advances each stationary clock. Marriage, party-absence semantics, overflow, actual relation policy and callback effects remain connected review questions.

The model retains a daily schedule as primitive activity-duration fields with optional organization identifiers and computes an allocated total; immediate activity is an enum with separate organization argument. This observation does not imply every optional combination is invalid or name a canonical owner without the schedule admission and consumer trace.
